install: npm ci && npx prisma generate && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq rsync openssh-client
start: if [ -n "${SSH_KEY:-}" ]; then echo 'SSH_KEY configured — run ./deploy/hetzner/deploy-platform.sh to deploy to Hetzner TEST'; elif [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-/dev/null}" ]; then echo 'SSH agent available — deploy via ./deploy/hetzner/deploy-platform.sh (requires deploy key in agent)'; else echo 'Add SSH_KEY (deploy private key) to Cursor Environment → Secrets to enable Hetzner deploy from cloud agents'; fi
